name: Werewolf's Den
source:
"Here comes the most annoying alarm sound~!" you say with your mind foggy with only a vague recollection of the life you've left behind. Despite that, you know you are on a bumpy ride. Live with your "friends(?)" as you go through your, not so normal college.

Can you pick up what each character is trying to tell you?

[From Itch.io]
